cards.label: The City
cards.text: A man in a suit that costs more than your flat buys you a coffee you didn't order, in a café you'd never choose. He introduces himself as "a friend of a friend", which in the City means nobody vouches for him.

cards.speaker: The Suit
cards.text: "I collect fate-type. Recreationally, you understand. Two hundred up front, I match it eightfold if the numbers land. If they don't — well. Markets."
He's already got his card reader out.

choices.label: Trade (£200)
choices.result_text: He taps his card against yours and doesn't blink. The transaction completes with the finality of all City transactions — you'll know how it went when you check your ore.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result_text: "Suit yourself," he says, and you both know exactly which word he chose.

cards.text: He's gone by the time you check your phone. Some men are only ever passing through.
